post.summary: Consume token and confirm totem checkpoint atomically
post.description: TOTEM role with matching device id. Accepts token or six-character code. Returns a separate KIOSK bearer token bound to this journey and totem, expiring after 30 seconds idle. Explicit activity via touch may renew up to five minutes absolute. At most 10 consume attempts per device/minute.
